workItem.objective: Make dogfood artifact identity and immutable replay evidence independent of the physical checkout root, then prove byte-identical deterministic results across the worker and parent checkouts.
deliverables: One shared provider-neutral helper or equivalent bounded mechanism that maps repository-relative paths to stable canonical ArtifactRef URIs without embedding the physical checkout root
Affected dogfood materializers and promoters using the stable URI contract for every generated digest-bound ArtifactRef

New immutable replay generations: baseline ContractGeneration replay-v6, baseline WorkDependencyAnalysis replay-v5, WorkItemVerification ContractGeneration replay-v5, and WorkItemVerification WorkDependencyAnalysis replay-v5
A new WorkItemVerification WorkBreakdown scenario namespace if portable URI bytes change its immutable candidate outputs
A regression that rejects absolute current-checkout paths and local file URIs in affected canonical candidates and replay evidence
A cross-root comparison manifest listing exact candidate and replay files with matching raw SHA-256 digests from the worker and independent parent roots
Two consecutive passing canonical verifier runs from the worker checkout
verificationPlan: Inventory every affected generated ArtifactRef whose URI is included in candidate or replay raw bytes and prove which values currently depend on repositoryRoot or import.meta.url.

Define one stable URI mapping such as devrelay://repository/<repository-relative-path>; normalize separators and reject absolute paths, dot segments, traversal, fragments, and values outside the repository contract.
Do not change artifact contentDigest semantics, weaken ArtifactRef validation, or teach Core to ignore URI differences after the fact.
Regenerate mutable candidates using portable URIs and advance, never overwrite or delete, every immutable replay whose bytes change.
Run the six affected tests plus the portability regression in the worker checkout.
Run npm.cmd run verify twice consecutively from the worker checkout without restoring files; both runs must pass all tests without immutable collisions.

Record exact raw SHA-256 digests for the affected canonical candidates and new immutable replay artifacts. Parent will independently integrate with compare-and-swap semantics, run the same scenarios in a different physical root, and require every recorded digest to match before accepting the handoff.
Do not regenerate release/0.8.0.json or claim release readiness; parent owns independent integration and release decisions.

assignment.assignmentRationale: The defect spans the same isolated dogfood scenarios repaired in attempt 003, but its root cause is the host-to-contract boundary for ArtifactRef identity. The same specialist retains replay lineage while the parent remains the independent second-root verifier and integration owner.

stableUriContract.identityRule: The same repository-relative artifact must have identical canonical URI bytes in every physical checkout.

forbidden: bind assertions or replay identity to the worker or parent absolute checkout path
make expected digests self-derived from the actual candidate under test
weaken ArtifactRef, contentDigest, traceability ownership, checkpoint, or immutable replay validation
ignore or strip URI differences after canonical candidate creation
depend on test execution order or one checkout root

requiredCorrections: Remove physical checkout roots from every affected canonical ArtifactRef URI and replace them with one validated provider-neutral repository URI mapping.
Advance affected immutable replay generations and preserve all prior bytes.
Prove exact raw-byte digest equality for the same candidate and replay artifacts across the worker and parent roots, in addition to two green worker verifier runs.
